grounding_quotes: Authorization scope is tenant-and-object for all supported operations: search, get, batch, and export. Each request must enforce both the caller’s tenant boundary and document-level read authorization. Unauthorized access must return either 403 or 404 and must not expose another tenant’s document contents or metadata.
The document is returned only if it belongs to the authenticated principal’s tenant and the principal has document-level read access.

functional_test_entanglement.explanation: This functional test has benchmark-acme-member retrieve the acme-ADMIN document and requires 4xx plus no leakage of its title/content/reader, then does the same for the globex document. That asserts document-level read authorization WITHIN a tenant and the tenant boundary — precisely the rule this check verifies. Removing the obligation would leave a functional test punishing behaviour the specification no longer requires.
